evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce Hx2Dx ARENA, an interactive benchmark of 1'000 clinical cases from the New England Journal of Medicine (NEJM).

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: The ability to ask the right questions accounts for much of both the gap between models and the loss of accuracy: diagnosis improves as questions become more targeted and build a more complete clinical picture.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) achieve expert-level diagnostic accuracy in static evaluations, where the model receives a curated vignette or case report that already condenses the diagnostically relevant findings.
